basics.name: Pranita Sapkal
basics.label: Product Designer
basics.summary: Product designer for the platforms that run one of India's largest logistics networks. On Meesho's Valmo network I'm the sole designer behind three products taken from 0→1 to launch: the systems that plan trips, manage transporters, and run vendor contracts, now used by transporters and managers across India. Partnering with product and engineering, I design the operating model, not just the screens. Earlier: 3 years across web, mobile, and design systems.

work.name: Meesho (Valmo Transportation)
work.position: Product Designer, Transporter Panel (SetuX) — live flagship
highlights: Designed SetuX, a unified transporter platform to accept trips, assign vehicles and drivers, track execution, confirm cost, and raise disputes, replacing scattered email and WhatsApp workflows.
Led the V1→V2 redesign that made completed trips clearer and added Hindi audio for low-literacy partners, lifting cost visibility from ~70% to ~96%.
Designed the upfront cost-acknowledgement flow, cutting invoice errors from ~20% to under 2% (~₹10 Cr impact).
Designed the disputes flow to raise, track, and resolve issues in one place, cutting the payout cycle from ~90 to ~7 days (NPS > 60).

work.name: Meesho (Valmo Transportation)
work.position: Product Designer, TMS Admin (Trip Creation, Placement & Multi-Origin)
highlights: Designed the Area Manager admin panel for bulk trip creation, turning managers into active moderators of data quality across ~100 sort centres (97% cost visibility, 99% compliance).
Redesigned multi-origin trip creation into a simple 2-click route builder, removing two workarounds that were corrupting trip data.

work.name: Meesho (Valmo Transportation)
highlights: Designing Valmo's contract-lifecycle system from 0→1, turning route plans into signed, running vendor contracts and replacing an offline spreadsheet process with one auditable source of truth.

Modeled the full contract lifecycle and designed the CLH manager workspace to assign transporters and rates (with cost guardrails and best-fit suggestions) plus a transporter side to review and accept, across 14 flows and 130+ screens.

work.name: Wizrdom
highlights: Designed end-to-end UI/UX for client web and mobile products, taking work from research and wireframes through prototypes to high-fidelity, dev-ready handoff.
Created social, graphic, and motion content for marketing, using performance metrics to refine what shipped.
Ran multiple projects simultaneously, presenting to stakeholders and mentoring junior designers.

work.name: Huntment
highlights: Designed DoJoin Ride, a multi-service app for the UAE market, delivering user flows, wireframes, and hi-fi interfaces across its features.
Partnered with cross-functional teams to align designs with business goals, running user testing to optimize the experience.

work.name: AuraSmart
highlights: Designed smart-home automation app experiences end-to-end, taking them from research and user flows to high-fidelity prototypes.
Built a reusable design system, running usability testing to validate and refine flows.
Shaped branding direction and improved UX writing across the product.

work.name: OnerosTech
highlights: Designed a personal-finance app (loan tracking, bill reminders) from lo-fi to hi-fi, adding micro-interactions to improve usability.
Researched real usability issues and applied UX principles to the solutions, also designing a sports-betting app interface for clarity and ease of use.
